value.rationale: The natural two-witness condition is exactly the one-vertex-deletion robustness margin for rank-five approximation to the countable random graph. An exact all-prime-power threshold and isolated q125 failure after success at q89 are not routine corollaries of one-witness extension or eventual character-sum sufficiency; they give a meaningful sharp arithmetic classification of a classical pseudorandom family.
